sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.

We confirm a binding volume of 20000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).
In our call of 2026-06-16 (doc:20260616-70620-M6) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We acknowledge your confirmed volume of 20000 units and are prepared to accept the 36-month term and 90-day payment period.
Therefore, we can offer a revised price of EUR 4.94 per unit for this package.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
